Players Committee card image of [[General Grievous (ALT) (Remastered January 2022)|General Grievous (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “Any stolen lightsaber may deploy on Grievous. Once per game, Grievous may steal a lightsaber from opponent's Lost Pile. Unless alone, may lose 1 Force to return Grievous (and your cards on him) to hand from a site you control. Immune to attrition < 4.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/generalgrievous_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93 793bf65] (15 January 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
